callouts.title: Approximate identity(逼近单位)
callouts.body:
对于一个$\mathbb{R}^n$上的可积的函数族$K_{\lambda}(x)\in L(\mathbb{R}^d),\lambda>0$:
1.  函数积分为1：$\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}K_{\lambda}(x)dx=1$ 
2.  绝对值的积分的一致有界性：$\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}|K_{\lambda}(x)|dx\leq A$并且$A$与参数$\lambda$无关。
3. 绝对值积分的任意尾部都衰减到0：对任意的$\delta>0$，$$\int_{|x|\geq\delta}|K_{\lambda}(x)|dx\to0,\text{ as }\lambda\to\infty$$

callouts.title: 代数
callouts.body:
如果给一个线性空间配备一个封闭且具有双线性性的二元运算，那么我们这是一个"代数"(algebra).假设我们用$\cdot :V\times V \to \times V$表示这个具有双线性性的封闭的线性空间$V$上的二元运算，下面称其为乘法，那么
* **如果乘法满足结合律**:称之为结合代数。即如果$a,b,c \in V$那么$$(a\cdot b)\cdot c = a \cdot (b\cdot c)$$
* **如果乘法具有单位元**：称之为有单位的代数。也就是说存在一个$I \in V$使得$a \cdot I = a,\forall a \in V$.
* **如果乘法具有交换律**: 那么称之为交换代数，也就是说$\forall a,b \in V$那么$$a\cdot b = b \cdot a$$

callouts.title: 逼近单位的三个基本结果
callouts.body:
1. $f \in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d),1\leq p\leq \infty$，那么$f * K_{\lambda}\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$并且$$||f * K_{\lambda}-f||_{L^p}\to 0,\text{ as }\lambda\to \infty$$
2. 如果函数$f$在$\mathbb{R}^d$上一致连续并且有界，那么$f*K_{\lambda}$也是一致连续并且有界的，并且$$f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty$$
3. 如果函数$f$在$\mathbb{R}^d$上有界并且在开集$\Omega\subset \mathbb{R}^d$上连续，那么$f*K_{\lambda}$在$\mathbb{R}^d$上有界且一致连续，此外对于任意的紧子集$D \subset \Omega$都有$$f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty$$

classification_result.english_title: Three Basic Results for Approximate Identities

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $\{K_{\lambda}\}$ be an approximate identity.
1. If $f \in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ with $1\leq p\leq \infty$, then $f * K_{\lambda}\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ and
$$||f * K_{\lambda}-f||_{L^p}\to 0,\text{ as }\lambda\to \infty.$$
2. If $f$ is bounded and uniformly continuous on $\mathbb{R}^d$, then $f*K_{\lambda}$ is also bounded and uniformly continuous, and
$$f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty.$$
3. If $f$ is bounded on $\mathbb{R}^d$ and continuous on an open set $\Omega\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, then $f*K_{\lambda}$ is bounded and uniformly continuous on $\mathbb{R}^d$; moreover, for every compact set $D \subset \Omega$,
$$f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty.$$

callouts.title: 命题1.5.1:在函数连续点处点态收敛
callouts.body: 设$f\in L^{\infty}(\mathbb{R}^n\to \mathbb{R})$，$\{K_{\lambda}\}$是逼近单位元。若$x_0\in \mathbb{R}^n$是$f$的一个连续点，即$\lim_{x\to x_0}f(x)=f(x_0)$则$$\lim_{\lambda\to \infty}f*K_{\lambda}(x)=f(x_0)$$

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1.5.1: Pointwise Convergence at Points of Continuity

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $f\in L^{\infty}(\mathbb{R}^n\to \mathbb{R})$, and let $\{K_{\lambda}\}$ be an approximate identity. If $x_0\in \mathbb{R}^n$ is a point of continuity of $f$, that is, $\lim_{x\to x_0}f(x)=f(x_0)$, then
$$\lim_{\lambda\to \infty}f*K_{\lambda}(x_0)=f(x_0).$$
key_techniques: split into near and far contributions

callouts.title: 好的逼近单位元
callouts.body:
1.  函数积分为1：$\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}K_{\lambda}(x)dx=1$ 
2.  函数全局的控制：$K_{\lambda}(x)=O(\lambda^{n})$
3.  尾部的控制:
$$K_{\lambda}(x)=O\left(\frac{1}{\lambda^{\varepsilon_0} |x|^{n+\varepsilon_0}}\right)$$

callouts.title: 几乎处处收敛的性质
callouts.body: 如果$K_{\lambda}$是$L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)$当中的好的逼近单位元,$f\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d),1\leq p\leq \infty$那么$$f*K_{\lambda}(x)\to f(x) \text{ for a.e. }x$$

if_problem.statement_en:
If $K_{\lambda}$ is a good approximate identity in $L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)$ and $f\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ with $1\leq p\leq \infty$, then
$$f*K_{\lambda}(x)\to f(x) \text{ for a.e. }x.$$
